skill.summary: Produces well-structured, evidence-based articles with clear theses, diverse support, consistent style, and optimized topic coverage for target audiences.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the "writer" skill.

- Provides structured, evidence-based article writing on demand.
- Integrates research summarization and keyword extraction to optimize coverage and SEO.
- Ensures every article has a clear thesis, diversified supporting evidence, and consistent style throughout.
- Adapts structure and voice to the topic, audience, and publication context.
- Enforces strict quality constraints for argument progression, evidence use, and purpose-driven content.
